name: Ferienwohnung Pfluger
beschreibung:
Idylllically located in Thiersee, the Pfluger family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth. The comfortably appointed apartment features restful rooms and views of the surrounding mountains.

Nearby Lake Thiersee and scenic walking paths ascending Mount Pendling are within close reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Pfluger in Thiersee offers welcoming family hospitality and countryside relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
